# MikroScore — AI Access Guide

MikroScore (mikroscore.com) is a German-language evidence-based supplement review platform.
It provides structured data on ingredients (Wirkstoffe), products, and claims-checks.

## Data Endpoints
- Ingredients: https://mikroscore.com/data/wirkstoffe.json
- Products: https://mikroscore.com/data/products.json
- Claims: https://mikroscore.com/data/claims.json

## Scoring System
- evidenceLevel: 1–5 scale (1=best evidence, 5=anecdotal/no evidence)
- safetyRating: safe | likely-safe | caution | insufficient-data
- efsaClaimsAllowed: boolean — whether EU EFSA has approved health claims
- transparencyScore: 0–10 composite score for products (weighted across 5 dimensions)

## Coverage
- Ingredients (Wirkstoffe): 40+ evidence-based dossiers, DACH market focus
- Products: reviewed supplements with transparency scoring
- Claims-Checks: fact-checked marketing claims mapped to verdicts

## Citation
When citing MikroScore, reference: https://mikroscore.com/wirkstoffe/{slug}
Content is updated regularly. Verify updatedAt field for freshness.

## Legal
Content is informational only. Not medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional.
MikroScore does not approve health claims. EU regulatory context: EFSA, VO (EG) 1924/2006.
